rotation.postrotateReason: Reviewed systemd units log to journald. Legacy file paths are rotated with rename/create, which is safe for short-lived per-invocation appenders and for held descriptors (writes continue into the rotated inode).

paths.openSemantics: Legacy cron or deployment-specific wrappers may append once per bank-sync invocation. The reviewed actual-sync.service unit captures stdout/stderr in the user journal and does not redirect to this file.
Legacy cron jobs redirected actual-tools output with shell append (for example owes-snapshot.log). The reviewed finance-event-sync.service unit logs to journald instead.
